data.name: Sabella
data.gender_notes: Sabella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘sabellus’, meaning ‘of Sabella’. Sabella was a Sabine goddess who protected and nurtured children. This name is rich in symbolism, representing safety, protection, and nurturing. It is an ideal choice for a little girl who embodies these qualities. The name Sabella carries the meaning “Shelter or refuge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Sabella usually hope their child will grow to embody shelter or refuge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sabella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shelter or refuge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabella total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: סבלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: סבלה הוא שם נשי שמקורו מהמילה העברית 'סבל' שפירושה 'לאסוף' או 'לקרוא'. הוא קשור לשורש 'ס-ב-ל' שפירושו 'להתפלל' או 'להשתחוות'. השם סבלה משויך לאחת הנשים שהיו נלוות לישוע ולתלמידים שלו, והוא מופיע בברית החדשה. השם מעביר הודעה של קשר עם אלוהים והתמסרות לו.

in_greek.name: Σαβέλλα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο πατέρας μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Σαβέλλα είναι ένα θηλυκό όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'סבלה' (Sabella) που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο πατέρας μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η Σαβέλλα αναφέρεται ως μία από τις γυναίκες που ακολουθούσαν τον Ιησού και τους μαθητές του. Το όνομα αυτό μεταφέρει μήνυμα σύνδεσης με τον Θεό και αφοσίωσης σε Αυτόν.

in_latin.name: Sabella
in_latin.long_meaning: Sabella est nomen femininum quod oritur ex voce hebraea 'סבלה' (Sabella) quae significat 'Deus est pater meus'. In Novo Testamento, Sabella commemoratur ut una ex mulieribus quae Iesum et discipulos eius sequebantur. Nomen hoc nuntium deferre connexionis cum Deo et devotionis ad Ipsum.

in_english.name: Sabella
in_english.long_meaning: Sabella is a feminine given name derived from the Hebrew root 'ס-ב-ל' (s-b-l), meaning 'to collect' or 'to pray'. It is associated with a woman mentioned in the New Testament as one of Jesus' followers. The name conveys a message of connection with God and devotion to Him. Historically, Sabella has been used in Christian tradition to signify a strong spiritual bond with the divine. The name Sabella symbolizes faith, piety, and a nurturing personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabella holds cultural significance in the Sabine people’s history. The name is derived from Sabella, a goddess revered by the ancient Sabine civilization of Italy. Known to protect and nurture children, this name represents the deep bond and care between parents and their offspring. Today, he name serves as a reminder of the strong family ties and cultures that have been passed down through generations. It also highlights the importance of motherhood and the role of mothers in nurturing and safeguarding the next generation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sabella calls to mind the divine protection and care bestowed upon us by the heavens. The goddess Sabella, who was said to watch over children, symbolizes the maternal love and protection that emanates not just from our earthly mothers, but also from God himself. This name can serve as a reminder that we are all under the loving care of a higher power, and that we can rely on this divine protection whenever we face challenges or struggles in life. It also calls to mind the importance of nurturing our spiritual selves, and cultivating a strong and unwavering connection with our Creator. Ultimately, the name Sabella represents love, protection, and the divine connection between mother, child, and God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sabella, derived from the Hebrew name "Shabael," means "God is my strength." This name symbolizes trusting in God's power and provision during life's challenges.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sabella remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
